text.p: :Delhi shares surge after budget clears parliament
Shares on the Delhi Stock Exchange rose steadily in brisk afternoon trade on Monday, spurred by parliament's approval of the Finance Bill of the 1997/98 (April-March) budget, brokers said.
At 12:45 p.m. (0715 GMT), the bourse's sensitive index had climbed 9.37 points to 781.38.
"The market has reacted positively to the approval of the Finance Bill and major players should accelerate their buying activity," said Harjit Singh of brokers Wadhwa Associates.
The lower house of parliament on Friday approved the Finance Bill, which was presented by Finance Minister P.Chidambaram on February 28 in an investor-friendly, tax-cutting budget.
Hero Honda shot up 32.25 rupees to 462.25 on rumours that the firm was considering a bonus issue.
Hindustan Lever shares rose 33 rupees to 1,118.
